name: Cislunar-Bajada
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by an ancient meteor crater. Beyond bioluminescent seas, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Around the radiation hotspot, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
